description: Fetch one public URL once, without a consent cookie, and report trackers present on the first HTML response and Set-Cookie headers. JavaScript is not executed. Each tracker includes a provider slug when the scanner catalog maps it to a fiche, and the result links to the StackLégal scanner page. This is not a legal qualification. The address and the caller IP are not stored. Limited to a few scans per 10 minutes.

url.description: Public http or https URL on port 80 or 443, with no username in the address.

name: scan_site
title: Scan a site before consent
